title: fix(core): preserve cells when structurally editing ragged GFM tables

issue_comments.body:
[![CLA assistant check](https://cla-assistant.io/pull/badge/signed)](https://cla-assistant.io/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor?pullRequest=127)
All committers have signed the CLA.

Before/after of the reproduction table (real browser, real mouse drag of the 年龄 grip onto 职位):

**Before** — ragged header (missing leading pipe) + trailing empty column, rendered as a 4-column widget:

![before drag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/changdapeng/Nexus-Editor/pr-assets/assets/01-ragged-before-drag.png)

**After** — columns swapped with every cell preserved; all rows normalized with leading/trailing pipes; the adjacent well-formed table byte-identical:

![after drag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/changdapeng/Nexus-Editor/pr-assets/assets/02-ragged-after-drag.png)
